hypergraphEditor.infoButtonTitle: Information about transversals and exact classes
hypergraphEditor.infoTransversalText: A set T of hypervertices is a transversal when it intersects every hyperedge: |T∩E_j| ≥ 1 for every E_j.
hypergraphEditor.infoExactText: An exact transversal selects exactly one representative from every hyperedge: |T∩E_j| = 1 for every E_j.
hypergraphEditor.infoCExactText: A hypergraph has a c-exact solution at level c when there is a set S such that every hyperedge has exactly c selected hypervertices: |S∩E_j| = c.
hypergraphEditor.infoXtText: Here XT is treated as the 1-exact case: exactly one hit per hyperedge. The Check XT button runs the independent XTREC test.
hypergraphEditor.infoRExactText: The r-exact analysis computes r* = max |T∩E_j| over minimal transversals. The hypergraph satisfies threshold r when r* ≤ r; XT corresponds to r = 1.
hypergraphEditor.infoStructuralXtText: The report checks sufficient conditions from the paper: module disjointness, duplicate/dominance reductions, laminarity, XTREC, star forest, and 1-safe/live assumptions.

docs.default.description: POOH (Power Objects of Hypergraphs) is research software for analysis and decomposition of Petri nets using hypergraph methods. It supports computation of P-invariants (Martinez-Silva), reduction to exact transversals (XT-hypergraphs, treated as the r = 1 special case of r-exact hypergraphs: 1-exact hypergraphs), colored hypergraph visualization and a graphical hypergraph editor with FRA reduction, transversals and XTREC checking, decomposition into state machine components, SFC generation for PLC prototyping, standalone (max,+) timing models, fuzzy exact transversals via alpha-cut and max E(T) optimization, and structural Takagi-Sugeno max-plus rule generation with an MPC/verification report skeleton. The tool is targeted at concurrent control systems research, reconfigurable control, and FPGA/PLC prototyping.
docs.algorithm.martinezDescription: Iterative method that constructs minimal P-invariants from the incidence matrix by augmenting rows and eliminating columns with mixed signs.
docs.algorithm.xtrecDescription: Recognition algorithm checking whether a selection hypergraph belongs to the class of exact-transversal hypergraphs (XT), i.e. the 1-exact case in the r-exact hypergraph direction.
docs.algorithm.fraDescription: Reduces the dual hypergraph by removing dominated hyperedges and isolating essential vertices.
docs.algorithm.fuzzyDescription: ALPHA pipeline that derives Petri/XT structural relations and T x T relation matrices, builds local max-plus models for SMC components, annotates weighted timed event graphs with critical cycles, computes fuzzy exact transversals through alpha-cuts with configurable membership weights, exports tidy mu(v,E) tables, runs an alpha-sweep table, optimizes max E(T) under size/coupling/lambda constraints, stores versioned research runs, and generates Takagi-Sugeno rules structurally instead of defining them manually.
